objective: Repair the zero-commit representativeness gap in M998 with a predeclared stratified bounded-window measurement of an additive block-reset execution schedule. Reuse frozen M785/M890/M896/M946 transaction and scheduling semantics; do not run a full row, alter the network algorithm, or infer continuous-M785 makespan from nonadditive slices.

first_principles_boundary.reason: port calendars, outstanding returns, terminal liveness and cross-window dependencies make continuous-schedule makespan nonlinear
first_principles_boundary.forbidden_estimator: sum or scale standalone M896/M946 prefix total_cycles by request-count ratio
continuous_m785_point_cycles_require: or an independently proved exact skip-ahead state capsule carrying every port calendar, outstanding return and live dependency
first_principles_boundary.selected_solution: define a real block-reset schedule whose measured blocks are additive by construction

conservation: every original source-service group appears in exactly one work block
every original output vector appears in exactly one commit block
every original transaction/address contribution is accounted exactly once excluding separately tagged reset overhead
reset overhead is reported separately and identically on candidate and baseline
dense commit address census matches frozen M785

strata.name: SOURCE_INIT_CENSUS
strata.membership: the complete one-time source-fetch transaction for one layer row
strata.required_observation: full source-fetch address/count/bytes and exact cycle fields

strata.name: COMPUTE_REGULAR
strata.membership: noncommit work block not assigned to DEPENDENCY_STRESS
strata.sampling: deterministic SRSWOR after sealed metadata index
strata.required_observation: at least one compute transaction and exact reset/fill/body/drain cycles

strata.name: DEPENDENCY_STRESS
strata.membership: noncommit work block with any psum external move, weight-refill external transaction, or dependency fan-in >=3
strata.sampling: deterministic SRSWOR after sealed metadata index
strata.required_observation: positive dependency/resource-wait evidence and exact reset/fill/body/drain cycles

strata.name: COMMIT_TAIL
strata.membership: one dependency-closed commit block containing at least one frozen dense commit address
strata.sampling: deterministic SRSWOR after sealed metadata index
strata.required_observation: positive commit request count and exact commit-sequence hash

sampling.adaptive_rule: double only strata contributing most design variance; never select by observed speedup

estimator.estimand: total cycles of the explicitly defined serial block-reset schedule
estimator.ci95: estimate +/- 2.365 * sqrt(variance); 2.365 is conservative for minimum n=8
estimator.paired_speedup: estimated baseline total cycles / estimated candidate total cycles
estimator.paired_speedup_ci95: log-ratio delta method with finite-population candidate/baseline covariance and the same 2.365 critical value
estimator.ci_interpretation: finite-population sampling uncertainty for the frozen row, not run-to-run stochastic variation
estimator.D1_treatment: not estimated; if shown later, add the same independently sealed common charge to both totals and retain non-decoder-complete label

primary_metrics: estimated candidate block-reset layer cycles with 95% CI
estimated matched-baseline block-reset layer cycles with 95% CI

decision_gates.between_5_and_10_percent: diagnostic estimate only; adapt sample if below cap
decision_gates.above_10_percent: NO_GO point cycle or speedup estimate; report bounds/coverage only
decision_gates.any_exact_mismatch: STOP and quarantine all window estimates

minimum_new_source.policy: additive wrapper only; never edit frozen M785/M890/M896/M946
required_functions: build metadata-only block census and freeze stratum membership before cycles
emit dependency-closed block-reset transactions with explicit boundary/fill/drain charges
split blocks only at complete service-group boundaries under 10K expanded requests
run M896 RUN-GTLS and M890 reference exact miter on the same block
seal each window independently before aggregation
apply the frozen finite-population paired estimator
minimum_new_source.d0_route: reuse frozen M896/M785 exact-binary record path
minimum_new_source.d2_d3_route: reuse frozen M946 selectors, M785 transaction generator and M896 exact_schedule
minimum_new_source.d1_route: no generator or scheduler call; emit only STRICT_COMMON_CHARGE identity

m1008_evidence.observed_gap: D2 and D3 10K prefixes pass numeric/cycle exactness but each has zero commit requests
